document.description: URL or path to the authoritative source-neutral COM Map Catalog provider document.

streamId.description: Opaque provider stream id consumed by the COM backend; it is not a public browser URL.

doNotRenderGeometryFill.description: When true, polygon geometry is metadata extent only and must not be displayed as a filled vector feature.

selectableInMap.description: Whether COM may expose the whole source as a normal map selection. Prefer layer metadata for user-facing selection.

backend.description: Optional backend marker, e.g. unconfigured, patroni-postgis, chmi-opendata or ndic-srti-lod, without exposing credentials.

objectCount.description: Present for PostGIS-backed providers when public.osm_poi is readable.

environmentGrid.description: Cataloged grid/field layer health, stable WGS84 grid alignment and upstream status.

boundaryReadModel.description: PostGIS administrative boundary read-model health, import age and feature count.

layerId.description: Recommended COM catalog layer id, e.g. public.mobile.network.

rendering.description: Provider-side rendering contract for geometries that are grid cells or raster extents rather than ordinary vector polygons.

transportMode.description: Normalized public-transport or road mode, e.g. bus, tram, train, metro, trolleybus, road.

routeShortName.description: Normalized route or line short name for transit vehicles.

destination.description: Normalized destination/headsign when provided by the source.

delaySeconds.description: Normalized delay in seconds when provided by the source.

vehicleId.description: Stable provider vehicle identifier for transit vehicles.

tripId.description: Provider trip identifier for transit vehicles.

occupancyStatus.description: Normalized GTFS-style occupancy status when provided by the source.

occupancyPercent.description: Vehicle occupancy estimate in percent when provided by the source.

speedMps.description: Vehicle speed in metres per second.

dataQuality.description: Indicates whether the mobile assessment is based on measurements, modelled coverage, both, or insufficient inputs.

btsStatus.description: Status of the concrete BTS/operator feed. `operator_feed_unavailable` means SIM has no authorized BTS/NOC status.

SituationDataBbox.name: bbox
SituationDataBbox.description: WGS84 bbox in west,south,east,north order. Defaults to configured Prague pilot bbox.

SituationDataTechnologies.name: technology
SituationDataTechnologies.description: Optional mobile coverage/mobile network technology filter. Alias `technologies` is also accepted.

SituationDataOperators.name: operator
SituationDataOperators.description: Optional mobile coverage/mobile network operator filter. The unified mobile_network layer currently publishes aggregate/unknown operator assessment.
